received_mid = mid * (1 - config.fee_rate) if side == 'buy' else mid
cost_per_quantity = fill - received_mid if side == 'buy' else abs(fill - mid) + fill * config.fee_rate

allowed_ast_changes.old_statement: asset_limit = max(0.0, (config.max_weight * nav - positions[symbol] * mid) / (mid + config.max_weight * cost_per_quantity))
allowed_ast_changes.new_statement: asset_limit = max(0.0, (config.max_weight * nav - positions[symbol] * mid) / (received_mid + config.max_weight * cost_per_quantity))

allowed_ast_changes.old_statement: gross_limit = max(0.0, (config.max_gross * nav - gross) / (mid + config.max_gross * cost_per_quantity))
allowed_ast_changes.new_statement: gross_limit = max(0.0, (config.max_gross * nav - gross) / (received_mid + config.max_gross * cost_per_quantity))

allowed_ast_changes.old_statement: quantity = min(quantity, cash / (fill * (1 + config.fee_rate)), asset_limit, gross_limit)
allowed_ast_changes.new_statement: quantity = min(quantity, cash / fill, asset_limit, gross_limit)

cash_delta, position_delta, fee_asset, fee_amount, fee_USDT_mid = _received_asset_fill(symbol, side, quantity, fill, mid, config.fee_rate)
fee = fee_USDT_mid

if positions[symbol] < 0:
